description: The figure is a two-level donut chart comparing response outcomes for two conditions, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” with three categories in each ring (six slices total across the two rings). In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the slices are Deceived in dark red at about 67.6%, Partially in mustard/yellow at about 23.5%, and Not Deceived in dark green at about 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the slices are Deceived in dark red at about 57.9%, Partially in mustard/yellow at about 31.6%, and Not Deceived in dark green at about 10.5%. Percentage labels are printed directly on the slices, and two legends on the right map colors to labels for the outer and inner rings; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged consistently around the circle rather than explicitly sorted by size.
